title: etbb-july-2024-may-2025-update.pdf — section 221
text:
72. Mind suggests these ways of asking about mental distress (as appropriate):160
• “You appear to be distressed by this situation. Is there anything which would help reduce
your anxiety?”
• “You seem to be distressed by this situation. Is there anything you would like to tell us
about your situation? Is there anything we can do to help?”

73. Ways to establish the mental health of a defendant in criminal proceedings where there is
reason for concern are set out below in the section “Mental health: defendants and the
criminal justice system”.
Criminal court procedure – statutory measures

74. The above principles apply to criminal courts as much as to civil courts. In addition, there are
specific statutory rules for vulnerable witnesses in criminal cases, which carry their own
terminology.
